# MM2Shark

Murder Mystery 2 value list and trade calculator at https://mm2shark.com.

Check item values, demand, and whether a trade is Win, Fair, or Lose before you accept.

## Site

- [Home](https://mm2shark.com/)
- [Value List](https://mm2shark.com/values/)
- [Trade Calculator](https://mm2shark.com/calculator/)
- [FAQ](https://mm2shark.com/faq/)
- [Privacy](https://mm2shark.com/privacy/)
- [Terms](https://mm2shark.com/terms/)

## Contact

- Email: contact@mm2shark.com

## Notes

MM2Shark is fan-made and unofficial. Not affiliated with Roblox or Nikilis.
Values are community estimates from public trading data (Traderie).
